concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-wechat-pay-wechat-pay-desktop-qr-payments-api-only]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured WeChat Pay web API-only redirect guide under a desktop-QR path; body gives `wechatpayWeb` request/return/webhook flow, not QR or expiry mechanics, and TEST/LIVE qualifications remain in the source.
warnings: The path says desktop QR but the captured title/body document `wechatpayWeb` redirect; no QR payload, scan flow or expiry is present.
The `/paymentMethods` currency link points to an Alipay URL, and v68 `/payments` versus v72 `/payments/details` examples do not prove version compatibility.
Adyen Checkout TEST examples coexist with a no-WeChat-Pay-test-platform statement; examples are not a provider sandbox transaction.
RedirectShopper and Pending/Received are intermediate; final AUTHORISATION webhook is specified for pending cases, and no actual capture/settlement/receipt is evidenced.
